text:
lina: Quick QA on the in-console Help panel — noticed inconsistent term for 'route' vs 'endpoint' across docs and the UI. In docs we use 'route' but the Console label says 'Endpoints'. Can we align?

sam: I saw that too. Which one is product-canonical? ping @anne and @ravi.

anne: We actually picked 'route' in the API spec/design doc, but the Console copy was carried over from legacy. I'm worried about swapping without a plan — users may already know 'Endpoints'.

ravi: Docs team here — we used 'route' because the API reference uses it. If Console shows 'Endpoints' the cross-links become confusing. We should either standardize or provide clear aliasing.

lina: UX nit: the Help panel inlay reads 'Learn about routes' and links to /docs/routes, but the anchor title on the doc page says 'Endpoints'. Users see two different words in quick succession.

sam: Two quick options: change Console copy to 'Routes' OR add a small parenthetical like 'Endpoints (Routes)'. I'd prefer one term across surfaces.

anne: Accessibility note: screen readers currently read the console widget as 'Endpoints dropdown', but the in-product docs panel has aria-label 'Routes help'. Inconsistent aria labels will confuse assistive tech.

docs-bot: FYI search analytics: queries for "routes" vs "endpoints" are roughly 45% / 55% over last 90 days — both are common.

ravi: Proposal: make 'Endpoint' the canonical external-facing term, but keep 'route' as an alias in the docs (glossary top-of-page). Then update console links to point to a canonical /docs/endpoints anchor that documents the alias.

lina: Layout concern: the Help panel header truncates in narrow widths — adding parentheses like 'Endpoints (Routes)' causes awkward wrapping. Maybe show 'Endpoints' and add a small 'Terminology' micro-link that opens the glossary.

sam: Good call. Could be: Console label = 'Endpoints' ; Help panel header = 'Endpoints — learn more' ; tiny link: 'Terminology: routes vs endpoints' that anchors to glossary entry.

anne: Mobile check: if the help link opens external docs, ensure we open in a new tab and include a clear back affordance. Also update aria-labels to match the chosen copy.

ravi: I'll draft the docs change and add the glossary alias 'route (endpoint)'. I'll also add redirects from /docs/routes -> /docs/endpoints for a couple months.

lina: I'll mock the Help panel with the small glossary link and test narrow widths / SR. Will post a Figma frame by EOD.

devex: After content/design changes, engineering should add a search synonym mapping (routes -> endpoints) and short redirect. I'll own the implementation and rollout.

sam: TL;DR: agree on 'Endpoints' as canonical external term, keep 'route' as alias in docs, add inline glossary link in Help panel, fix aria labels and narrow-width wrapping. Owners: docs=ravi, design=lina, eng=devex. :+1:

lina: Thanks — I'll attach the mock when ready and tag everyone.
